relevance_note: Case series of three Danon disease families with LAMP2 null mutations: "LAMP2 gene mutations were identified in all three male patients who showed LAMP-2 protein deficiency and in the heterozygote female patient 4".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; a Python script in the scratch directory assembled the JSON and cut table-row spans (Table 1 and Table 2 row segments from the patient label through the cited cell), which were checked against the tables. Five people: Patients 1-4 (own labels; Patient 4 is the mother of Patient 3) and one previously published female from ref 21 mentioned in the Discussion with sex and a protein finding (kept under the v4 in-passing rule; no variant printed so no variant row). The six other screened patients without LAMP2 mutations are out of scope (cohort_size_as_stated = 9 screened biopsies). Pedigree relatives in Figure 1 are only drawn, not described, so get no rows. Age at onset: earliest stated manifestation (hepatic signs at 9 and 12 years for Patients 2 and 3, per the text; Table 1 gives muscle onset 22 and 18). Age at last evaluation from Table 1 'Age and muscle involvement at last examination' (Patient 2: 22, though he died at 29). Age at diagnosis of Danon disease is not stated; Table 2 ages at hypertrophic cardiomyopathy diagnosis are used as onset of that feature. Variants are printed without 'c.'/'p.' prefixes and without a transcript (GenBank AC002476.1 was used for primer design and NM_013995 for RT-PCR primers only), so transcript is 'not reported'. Contradictions/ambiguities: the text says 'Each patient showed a different and previously unreported mutation' although Patients 3 and 4 (son and mother) share 294G>A (W98X) in Table 1; Table 1 protein column is '-' for the two frameshifts while the text gives fsX7 and fsX8; Table 2 cells for Patient 3 read 'WPW SV' and 'arrhythmia' (apparently 'SV arrhythmia' split across columns) so supraventricular arrhythmia was not recorded for Patient 3; Table 2 abbreviations (AVB, AF, SVT, NSVT) have no legend in this conversion. Table 1 '+' / '-' symbols (family history, MR) are not defined; '-' was never used to exclude; the MR '+' for Patient 3 is recorded as observed together with the MR legend. Inheritance for Patient 3 recorded as maternal because Table 1 lists the same 294G>A/W98X for his mother (Patient 4) and the text calls her the heterozygote. 'abnormal' transaminases (Patients 1 and 2) were taken as elevated liver enzymes on the checklist. The group sentences 'In two patients, ICD was implanted for ventricular tachycardia or fibrillation' and 'Three of the four patients developed severe and progressive heart failure' do not name the patients and were not assigned. Normal findings recorded per D-27: CK normal and cognitive records normal (Patient 4), negative hepatitis serology (Patients 2, 4), hepatic biopsy normal (Patient 3, recorded as written).
